notes.title: Bug Fixes Update v1.2.2 and Switch layout
notes.content:
Changes in v1.2.2 (5a75d6f0):
- Fixed the video intro on Linux
- Fixed the endless explosion sounds at the end of the game
- Add the Nintendo Switch controller layout as an option for the tooltips
- Do not allow the game to pause if some UI is up, this can cause issues with dialogues and credits

notes.title: Summer sale 🚨 20% off 🚨 and Game Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32006579/9e8209e4b5cfd02f45abfd01c8d2c8dabc5c7f38.png

Hi everyone, the summer sale is here and WarriOrb is 20% off until 9 July!
Along with this we also have a game update, let us know what you think.

Change list for version v1.2.1:


 Added a game speed slider where you can speed up the game if it was not fast enough for you
 Fix enemies to not be super fast if the game FPS was too high
 Fix game timer to correctly count the time for higher FPS
 Fix for double projectile spawn
 Many sound fixes
 Settings UI is easier to look at and it is more responsive
 New difficulty names to give a better idea about what to expect from them
 Final boss balancing: more time to attack during phase 2, slightly less phase 2 HP


Some localization is still missing, will be added soon enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32006579/d92e1a9662d1f2dfaeb9ff0575e06bf622bc4a4c.png

Twitter @NotYetDevs

Cheers,
The Not Yet Team.

notes.title: Looking for testers for patch 1.2
notes.content:
Hey, we are experimenting with speed changes and we would like to get some feedback.

The game speed is set to 1.25x by default (It can be changed in the Game Settings tab) in the beta branch testing on steam, see the screenshot below on how to access it. 

We would love to hear your take on how the game feels with 1.25x speed (or another speed you set) compared to the normal one.

To test this just right click on the game properties -> Beta tab -> select "testing" from the dropdown.

notes.title: The Forgiving Controls Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
We got a lot of feedback that the game is too unforgiving with the controls so we got to work fixing that :).

Changes in v1.1.1 (8982571b):

 Hide mouse by default when using gamepad or when the main menu is not open
 Set Merciful bounce mode to be Always On so that you can still jump even after you bounced
 Add Coyote Jump so that you have a small window after you fall to jump
 Modify jump & roll movement to be more forgiving
 Modify evil enemy path in the jump & roll tutorial to not kill you on respawn.
 Add a death counter for each save slot + at the top of the main menu (for the current save slot)
 Fix sword special jump bug


Let us now how it feels in the comments, discord
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188787/d92e1a9662d1f2dfaeb9ff0575e06bf622bc4a4c.png

or Twitter @NotYetDevs

The Not Yet Team

notes.title: WarriOrb v0.8
notes.content:
We just published a new patch with a few smaller improvements! 

GERNERAL

- Modified default controller layout (A is jump now)
- Improved character look, which is way more visible in most environment
- New combat music, intense music is added to some survive for x sec traps
- Short mini-cutscene on Act 1 start
- Character hitreact improvment (Maintainer strike)
- Character can switch and cast spells even if Spellcaster isn't the active item
- SilverKeys are replaced with Memory Crystals
- Huge SFX update, including ambients
- Improved drone attack effects
- Trap before first sewer lever is deactivated if the lever is pulled
- Small level and environment design updates
- Dialogue improvements

BUG FIXES

- Fix wrong damage amount in some case
- Fix for some weapon in hand glitch at the start of a dialogues/rest
- Fix music staying intense after certain traps
- Fix teleport if character is armed

BALANCES
- Decreased capacity cost for Green Flamestone and Energystone
- Decreased damage for some traps


Our discord server can be found here.

notes.title: Warriorb v0.7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32006579/2f513808c1070d2b1fe773603269bc00d89ef95f.jpg

We focus more on the later parts of the game now, but this update still contains some bigger changes:


 Invulnerability for a short time after a hit is taken to avoid unfair deaths
 Character is healed and spells are regained after an enemy group is defeated
 Miniboss projectile modified to be destroyable with strikes
 Certain spells are not casted if there is no target/need for the spell
 Fixed character bounces on floor in roll mode in places where he should not
 Quite Huge SFX update
 Fixed enemy not moving in the test stone area
 Fixed order of RB and LB buttons on bounce tutorial decal
 Better controller support on linux and automatic detection on first startup
 Improved reflections
 Minor performance improvements
 Can move in main menu and settings with controller dpad
 Many more smaller fix

notes.title: Warriorb v0.6 & New Trailer, Info, Screenshots
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32006579/b08391744ab391c4b24e1ef964a7c74021a4c393.jpg
Hello world.

This is our first post here, until now we only posted updates in our discord server.

We will try from now on to also post updates here.

First things first, we updated our steam page with a new trailer, gifs and screenshots.

If you want to test the game you can come to our discord server and request a key :D

v0.6 Changelog

GERNERAL 

Miniboss vfx improvements
Environment upgrades
Option to disable the "resisted damage" floating icons
All enemies are moved to Enemy Groups
Gatekeeper casts a teleport spell before the teleport to sewer level happens
Wrong camera angles are removed from the game
Soulstone tooltip contains the "Soulkeeper can't be used here" icon
Merchant music is played in the room of the merchant and not only during dialogues
Some combat area is modified to be Soulkeeper free zone
Inactive Dialogue Images go gray instead of transparent
Huge Dialogue Text Update
 

BUG FIXES 
 
Fixed unintended sfx around secret science society
Baseball Hat + Sword will spawn only one hit number and not two on enemy hit
Unintended bounces are stopped while rolling on stairs
 

BALANCES 
 
Protective transmutation (Witch Hat) transforms enemies to boot on overlap damage as well
Slightly more Valuable in the chapter
Reduced damage for some traps
